description: Agent Real Estate: submit a lease as written with the summary given to the principal, each with the same terms: the rent with its amount, currency, period (week, month or year) and due day; each fee besides rent with its name, amount and whether it recurs; the term with its start and end days; the renewal with its kind (none, an option, automatic or month to month), the days of notice to stop it and the rent increase on renewal; the deposit with its amount, the days to return it and what may be deducted; the termination terms with the days of notice and the fee to end early; and each side’s text. The signed report gives the rent on each side with its period and due day, the fees missing from the summary, higher in the lease and lower in the lease, the term on each side, the renewal kind, increase and notice on each side, the deposit amount, refund days and deductions the summary leaves out, and the early termination fee and notice on each side, and counts them, and names a mismatched lease: rent unlike the summary, a recurring fee the summary leaves out, a fee higher than the summary states, a term unlike it, renewal terms unlike it (an automatic renewal the summary does not give, or a higher increase), a deposit unlike it and an early termination fee higher than it states; then a one-time fee the summary leaves out, a fee lower than it states, another due day, a longer deposit refund period or deductions it leaves out, and longer termination or renewal notice, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A lease with no rent or no term, a summary with no rent or no term, or a summary silent on fees, renewal, the deposit or termination that the lease states leaves the lease unverified. Fees match by name without case or punctuation. This reads a property lease against its summary: wever_vendor-lockin-check reads a service vendor’s lock-in and exit terms, not a landlord’s lease, and wever_verify-and-release and wever_workorder-release release conditional and escrow payments for delivered work, which are release mechanics, not lease terms. Verdict realty_lease_mismatched, realty_lease_partial, realty_lease_unverified or realty_lease_matched. POST /api/realty-lease-check. Reads the property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, appraisal, listing, brokerage or external write. Agent Real Estate reads supplied property records after the fact and checks them against themselves and against the summary or approval given to the principal: a listing, the title and ownership record, a valuation, the seller disclosure, a lease, an offer or purchase agreement, an inspection report and a closing statement. Beside it, the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read purchases of tokenized asset shares, while a realty check reads conventional property records; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read policies and coverage, which a realty check never reads; and the payment escrow tools such as wever_agent-escrow-lite hold and release funds, while a realty check holds nothing. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-real-estate-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-real-estate/.
